title: free-disk-space limitations
description: What the binary does not do, or cannot know. The README's Caveats state the user-facing ones; these records trace them to the code.

entities.title: Shared blocks are invisible
entities.summary: The tool cannot tell whether a file already shares blocks with another (an APFS clone), so dedupe's saving is an upper bound and summed sizes can differ from the space actually freed.
entities.impact: A dedupe or cleanup can report more than the volume gains; snapshots and other writers widen the gap.
entities.workaround: Compare the free-space change on a --sample run before going broad; each command prints it beside the summed sizes.

entities.title: Compression, cloning and Finder are macOS only
entities.summary: compress, dedupe --apply and emptying the Trash refuse to run elsewhere; the daemon install needs launchd.
entities.impact: Off macOS the scan, its reports, the dry runs and the folder and dev cleanups work; compression, cloning, emptying the Trash and the daemon install do not.

entities.title: Dedupe compares only same-named files
entities.summary: Only files with the same leaf name and size, among those the last scan recorded, are hashed; identical files under different names, or outside the scanned tree, are never found.
entities.impact: Some duplicate space is left unclaimed.

entities.title: Compressed files are not deduped
entities.summary: A file that carries the compressed flag is never replaced by a clone, so dedupe should run before compress.
entities.impact: Running compress first removes those files from dedupe's reach.

entities.title: Docker is cleaned only when already running
entities.summary: The tool never starts Docker Desktop, and never deletes containers or volumes; when it does clean, it stops every running container and quits Docker Desktop.
entities.impact: Docker's disk image is not shrunk when Docker is not running; when it is, running containers are stopped.

entities.title: The daemon checks only while the Mac is awake and in use
entities.summary: The cadence counts awake time, the daemon never schedules a wake, and a check falling while the display sleeps is skipped.
entities.impact: A Mac that is mostly asleep, or runs with its display off, is rarely or never checked.

entities.title: The login item holds one binary's path
entities.summary: The plist names the absolute path of the binary that ran install, and the settings given then.
entities.impact: Moving or upgrading the binary, or changing a setting, needs another daemon install.
entities.workaround: Run daemon install again after moving or upgrading the binary.

entities.title: The daemon's log is never rotated
entities.summary: Each check adds a line and each cleanup its whole report to ~/Library/Logs/free-disk-space.log; nothing trims it.
entities.impact: The log grows for as long as the login item runs.
entities.workaround: Delete or truncate the log by hand.

entities.title: Downloads is emptied whole
entities.summary: The downloads target removes everything in ~/Downloads, hidden files included, with no age or type filter, and all includes it.
entities.workaround: Name the targets instead of all.

entities.title: Compression needs a ditto that really compresses
entities.summary: Where ditto --hfsCompression reports success but writes plain copies (the code and README name macOS 26/27), compress refuses to run.
entities.impact: No files are compressed on such a system; the scan, dedupe and clean are unaffected.

entities.title: A resumed clean trusts steps up to 12 hours old
entities.summary: Within 12 hours of an interrupted applying clean, the next applying run skips the folders, artifacts and targets it finished, even if they have filled again since.
entities.impact: Space that came back into a folder emptied before the interruption is not reclaimed by the resumed run.
entities.workaround: Run clean --apply again after the resumed run completes; it starts afresh.
